title: David Ruiz: a three-fingered humanoid species, not extraterrestrial

tellings.quote: Never in the eight years I've been researching have I mentioned or said the word extraterrestrial. Never. We are talking about humanoid species. We are talking about perhaps a hominid like us, a three-fingered hominid.

plain: Strange three-fingered bodies found in Peru belong to a humanoid species, maybe a hominid like us, and not to beings from another planet. That is the view of David Ruiz, a researcher who says he has studied them for eight years and has never once used the word extraterrestrial. If he is right, it would point to an unknown human-like species here on Earth.
